description: Gets one bookable price for a hotel (for example one from find_hotels_on_route) for a person who has hands-free booking turned on — Trucker Guide members who switched it on in the Autonomad app. It prices the hotel's cheapest room (refundable first) for the stay and returns `spoken`: read it to the person word for word. It names the hotel, the nights, the total with taxes, any amount paid at the hotel, the cancellation terms and the card. Then wait. Only if the person clearly says yes to that price, call confirm_route_hotel with the quote_id and the total_cents you read. A quote lasts about 4 minutes. Quoting books nothing and charges nothing. If the answer says hands-free booking isn't turned on, tell the person they can turn it on in the Autonomad app while parked. If it says hands-free booking is for Trucker Guide members, say exactly that.

check_in.description: Check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD): usually today in the driver's own time zone.

property_id.description: The hotel's property_id, as find_hotels_on_route or search_hotels returned it (e.g. 'LA-12345').

rooms.description: Rooms (default 1, at most the number of adults).

name: quote_route_hotel
